purpose: Check the representation/repair contract, not automatic extraction accuracy.
boundary: Already exposed registration and privilege source records plus authored structural controls; no new natural tasks, protected inputs, code outcomes, paper or Pair changes.
cases: Exact saved registration layer-only patch remains rejected.
Explicit withdrawal preserves unknown and closes requirement/impact dependencies.
An unaffected privilege pair remains mechanically usable.
Operation predicate remains identical when participant/guard/independent-order fields change; decoded bindings and graph relations change.
A normalized open operation can be frozen and its input corrected without changing the predicate or frozen research meaning.
acceptance: All mechanical and preservation invariants pass. Unresolved source interpretations may remain blocked; no requirement that the registration candidate becomes usable.
semantic_judgments: Authored diagnostic controls; no new independent model/human gold judgments.
tests: Extend existing representation invariant tests without increasing the default case count; focused checks followed by one clean full reviewer-suite run.
implementation_scope: Existing source record compiler/review/patch path only; same call limits and source schema. Frozen prior artifacts retain their exact original source.
